lines: Thank you... I thought I was going to be stuck there forever.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Are you okay? How did you end up in that net?

lines: I usually stay in my burrow, but something shiny went past and I followed it.
I didn't even notice the net until I couldn't move.
Oh! Right. I'm a garden eel. I don't usually swim this far from home.
I'm Silas, by the way. Sorry, I should've said that sooner.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'm Penni. Nice to meet you, Silas.

lines: Penni... it's nice to meet you, too.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I came down here to catch fish for my quota. This wasn't exactly what I had in mind.

lines: A quota...? Oh. Well, I know these waters pretty well.
Maybe I could help you find the fish you're looking for?

choices.text: Only if you're feeling up to it.

lines: Really? Oh! Okay. I know where some of the fish like to hide.
I think so. Actually... it'd be nice to see more than just my burrow for once.
Um... would it be all right if I swam with you for a while?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Sure. Just stay out of my net this time, okay?
